findings.title: Cleartext Credentials in Network Share
findings.description: Domain-accessible SMB share \\FS01\Finance contains PowerShell deployment scripts with hardcoded plaintext credentials for the svc_deploy service account.
findings.evidence:
Share accessible by all authenticated users (Everyone:Read).
Path: \\FS01\Finance\IT\scripts\deploy.ps1
Line 47: $cred = New-Object System.Management.Automation.PSCredential('IRONGATE\svc_deploy', (ConvertTo-SecureString 'W!nter2023Deploy#' -AsPlainText -Force))

findings.title: LSASS Credential Dumping — No LSA Protection
findings.description: LSA protection (RunAsPPL) is not enabled. LSASS process memory can be dumped by a local administrator, exposing cached domain credentials in NTLM and plaintext form.
findings.evidence:
procdump64.exe -accepteula -ma lsass.exe lsass.dmp
Secrets extracted with mimikatz sekurlsa::minidump / logonpasswords
Recovered: jmarsh (IRONGATE\IT Manager) NTLM hash

findings.title: Telnet Enabled on Core Network Switch
findings.description: Telnet (TCP/23) is enabled on the core switch. Telnet transmits authentication credentials and all traffic in cleartext, exposing network management credentials to any on-path attacker.
findings.evidence:
nmap -sV -p 23 10.10.10.1
PORT   STATE SERVICE VERSION
23/tcp open  telnet  Cisco telnetd

telnet 10.10.10.1 — successfully connected, banner: Irongate-Core-SW-01

findings.title: SNMP Default Community Strings (Public/Private)
findings.description: The core switch responds to SNMP v2c queries using default community strings 'public' (read) and 'private' (read-write). This exposes the full network topology and allows configuration changes.
findings.evidence:
onesixtyone -c /usr/share/seclists/Discovery/SNMP/snmp.txt 10.10.10.1
10.10.10.1 [public] Cisco IOS Software...
10.10.10.1 [private] ...

snmpwalk -v2c -c public 10.10.10.1 .1 → full MIB walk, ARP/routing tables

findings.title: Local Administrator Password Reuse Across Servers
findings.description: The local Administrator account uses the same password across multiple servers (FS01, BACKUP01). This allows lateral movement across the server LAN once any single host is compromised. LAPS is not deployed.
findings.evidence:
crackmapexec smb 10.10.20.0/24 -u administrator -p 'Irongate2019!' --local-auth
10.10.20.10  445  FS01      [+] IRONGATE\administrator:Irongate2019! (Pwn3d!)
10.10.20.50  445  BACKUP01  [+] IRONGATE\administrator:Irongate2019! (Pwn3d!)

findings.title: Pulse Secure VPN — Potential CVE-2021-22893
findings.description: The Pulse Secure SSL VPN appliance appears to be running version 9.1R11 which is vulnerable to CVE-2021-22893, an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability via a buffer overflow in the web interface. Not exploited per ROE.
findings.evidence:
Version fingerprint from HTTP response headers:
X-Pulse-Version: 9.1R11.0

Ref: https://kb.pulsesecure.net/articles/Pulse_Security_Advisories/SA44784/

findings.title: Unauthenticated Tomcat Manager Interface
findings.description: Apache Tomcat Manager application is accessible at /manager/html on port 8080 without IP restriction. Successful authentication would allow WAR file deployment and remote code execution.
findings.evidence:
curl -I http://10.10.10.200:8080/manager/html → HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized (reachable)
Default credential attempts failed. Brute force not attempted per ROE.

findings.title: Unregistered Host in DMZ
findings.description: An unidentified host exists in the DMZ subnet that does not appear on the client's asset register. SSH and HTTPS services are running. Possible rogue device, forgotten test system, or unauthorized access.
findings.evidence:
nmap -sV 172.16.50.20
PORT     STATE SERVICE VERSION
22/tcp   open  ssh     OpenSSH 7.4 (protocol 2.0)
8443/tcp open  ssl     unknown

Not present in asset inventory provided by client.

findings.title: SMB Null Session / Anonymous Enumeration Denied
findings.description: Domain controllers correctly deny anonymous/null session SMB enumeration. RestrictAnonymous is set appropriately.
findings.evidence:
crackmapexec smb 10.10.20.5 -u '' -p ''
[-] IRONGATE\: STATUS_ACCESS_DENIED

Net use \\10.10.20.5\IPC$ '' /user:''
System error 5 — Access is denied.
